author: Merle L. Morgan
title: Istanbul trolleybus 18 on route 34 in 1981.jpg
description: Istanbul trolleybus 18, in service on route 34, taking the curve from Alemdar Caddesi onto Hüdavendigar Caddesi, in October 1981. No. 18 was a 1962-built Alfa Romeo 910F trolleybus with a body by Aerfer and electrical equipment by Ansaldo. It was one of 100 such trolleybuses purchased from Ansaldo in 1962 by the Istanbul trolleybus system , and which entered service there in 1962 and 1963. The Istanbul system closed in 1984. No. 18 was one of several Istanbul trolleybuses acquired by the Izmir trolleybus system , becoming No. 118 in its fleet (by 1989, at least).
